$comment: AdoptionEvidenceV1 lives in dotmac_starter_mt and is COPIED here, because
the dossier gate this repository must run cannot work without it. Rule 24:
copying is a one-time extraction, never a permanent fork or a second
writer. Two copies with no control is how they silently disagree — and the
thing that would disagree here is the vocabulary that decides whether
adoption claims are true, so the drift would be self-concealing.
The pin names a COMMIT, never a branch. A moving ref would let the Starter
change underneath the check and the check would keep passing.
